name: desert-rock
title: Piatra (chilia de piatră a lui Avva Moise) și schitul
units: engine units (figure 4.2 tall), three.js Y-up, +Z towards the usual camera

cell.note: in front of the stone cell door, facing out (towards the camera side)

cell-door.note: standing in the doorway, facing out (enter / leave the cell)

cell-in.note: inside the stone cell, just behind the closed door

cell-deep.note: deep inside the stone cell, facing the shelf with the cross (praying, seen through the open door)

yard.note: the dry yard in front of the stone cell

center.note: the middle of the yard (the acting area)

rock.note: at the foot of the Rock, facing it

schit.note: in front of the white cell of the schit, facing away from it (towards the Rock, -Z)

schit-door.note: in the doorway of the white cell, facing out (-Z)

schit-in.note: inside the white cell, just behind its closed door

path-near.note: on the path from the schit to the Rock, facing along it towards the stone cell

path-mid.note: on the path from the schit to the Rock, facing along it towards the stone cell

path-far.note: on the path from the schit to the Rock, facing along it towards the stone cell

offstage-left.note: out of frame on the left path (enter walking +X)

offstage-front.note: far towards the camera side (enter walking -Z)

wide.note: the yard, the stone cell, the Rock on the right

schit.note: the white cell of the schit (looking +Z)

notes: Stone cell (chilie-piatra ×6.5): centre [4, -11], doorway at [2.90, -6.68] (door:cell, hinge on the left, opens outwards); inside: anchors cell-in, cell-deep. White cell of the schit (chilie-alba ×7.5) at [-14, 36], turned 172° (its door towards -Z) at [-13.31, 31.10] (door:schit). The Rock [18.5, -16].
